spec2def(ufat.dll ufat.spec)

# ufat.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ufat-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(ufat_shims OBJECT ufat.c)
target_link_libraries(ufat_shims PRIVATE vfatlib libntdll)
add_cargo_module(ufat ufat-cargo ufat.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ufat_shims psdk xdk)
